content.title: Transportation Committee
content.summary: The Transportation Committee is a citizen-led group focused on enhancing the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of the city's multi-modal transportation system through project prioritization and funding evaluations. Meetings are held at City Hall on the fourth Wednesday of each month at 5:30 pm, and the committee consists of 12 volunteer members who serve three-year terms and must be residents. Recruitment for new members will begin in December.
content.body:
## Overview

The Transportation Committee is a citizens’ committee that studies, recommends, and participates in a variety of efforts to foster a safe, efficient, and sustainable multi-modal transportation system. The Committee is involved in the prioritization of projects, bike, and pedestrian studies, and evaluating transportation funding options.

## Meeting Information

- 5:30 pm
- 4th Wednesday of each month
- City Hall

- 3 year terms

## Interested in Joining the Transportation Committee?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
